player_humanoid.description: A brave humanoid adventurer in armor or traveling clothes. Represents the player on their journey.

player_creature.description: A strange alien or robotic creature. Curious and friendly rather than threatening.

hazard_slime.description: A gelatinous blob blocking the path. Comes in various colors (green for forest, red for fire, blue for ice).

hazard_spike.description: Sharp metal or stone spikes protruding from the ground. A static hazard.

hazard_fire.description: Burning flames or lava erupting from the ground. Clearly signals heat and danger.

hazard_enemy.description: A roaming monster, bat, or skeleton that actively threatens the player.

collectible_coin.description: A shiny gold coin. The standard currency of the realm.

collectible_gem.description: A sparkling crystal or gemstone in vibrant colors. Highly valuable.

collectible_special.description: A magical star or a healing heart. Represents a rare bonus or powerup.

collectible_key.description: A rusty iron or golden key. Used to unlock doors or progress.

obstacle_rock.description: A solid boulder or stone block. Blocks movement but can be navigated around.

obstacle_terrain_block.description: A brick wall or wooden crate. Acts as a static physical barrier.

goal_flag.description: A brightly colored flag on a pole. Clearly marks the finish line.

goal_door.description: A wooden or iron door. The exit from the current room or level.
